admin_builds_description: The Sons of the Forest patches that field reports, compatibility badges and the Patch Radar refer to. Exactly one is current.

admin_builds_field_breaking_hint: The patch broke mods (new game version for RedLoader, changed assemblies…).

admin_builds_delete_text: Only builds nobody has reported on can be deleted.

admin_eco_matrix_description: Each change is saved at once. Add a note when something only partly works.

admin_tax_field_icon_hint: A Lucide icon name, e.g. wand-sparkles.
admin_tax_field_legacy_hint: Old slugs that redirect here, separated by commas.

admin_tax_tags_empty_text: Create curated tags to describe mods beyond their category.
admin_tax_field_group_hint: Groups tags in the filters, e.g. gameplay.

admin_awards_empty_text: The first Mod of the Week is chosen automatically on Monday; staff picks are yours.
admin_awards_delete_text: The award disappears from the mod page, the landing and the creator’s profile.
admin_awards_form_description: The mod is announced where the award shows (landing, mod page, profile and Discord for the Mod of the Week).
admin_awards_override_text: If a Mod of the Week already exists for these dates, this one takes its place.
admin_awards_field_reason_hint: Shown with the award. Up to 500 characters.
admin_picker_placeholder_mod: Search mods by name or manifest ID
admin_ann_description: The banner under the site header. Messages fall back to English in languages without a translation.
admin_ann_empty_text: Use them for patches, maintenance or community news.

admin_ann_field_message_hint: One or two short sentences, no Markdown.
admin_ann_field_href_hint: A site path such as /patch-radar, or an https:// address.

admin_ann_field_ends_hint: Leave empty to keep it until you end it.
admin_ann_delete_text: It disappears from the site within a few minutes.

admin_tpl_description: The reasons rangers pick when they approve, reject or ask for changes. Authors read them in their language.
admin_tpl_invalid_text: Fix the marked templates before saving.
